items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Lester was sort of past then, but it was my favorite, you know I like the old stuff.

ctx.x: Lester was sort of past then, but it was my favorite, you know I like the old stuff. And so I didn’t do much with the dance band. I think I played a little flute, lousy flute, and a little solo on something. But so what I did was by that time I’m in New York and I’m starting to play, and I got in with a crowd, you know a crowd of guys like my age and maybe a couple of guys from the Jazz Club in Brooklyn. And what happened was there used to be a Lindy’s or whatever it was called, it was on Broadway, high 40s,…
